digest.en: The U.S. military is launching new strikes on Iran, while Taiwan's path to victory remains unclear. In contrast, Asia's central banks are quietly writing the rules for AI finance, a development that could have far-reaching implications for global economic stability. Meanwhile, the humanitarian crisis in the DR Congo deepens as hunger hampers the Ebola response.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Warehouse In Russia
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries warehouse in the Ryazan region, Russia, setting the building on fire. articles.summary: As the US Senate prepared to vote on a sweeping bipartisan sanctions package targeting Russia and Iran, Democratic Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, a co-sponsor of the legislation, said the measure reflects renewed bipartisan resolve to squeeze the Kremlin war machine and reinforce support for Ukraine. articles.title: Mount Olympus and D-Day beaches among new World Heritage Sites
articles.summary: From the peaks of Mount Olympus in Greece to the shores of the “D-Day” beaches in France, 25 cultural or natural landmarks from across the globe have been newly inscribed on the World Heritage List, updated annually by the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). articles.title: HIV, hepatitis, STI gains at risk as funding falls, WHO warns
articles.summary: Years of progress in tackling HIV, viral hepatitis and sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are at risk of stalling, leaving millions of people without access to life-saving prevention, testing and treatment, the World Health Organization (WHO) has warned. HIV, hepatitis, STI gains at risk as funding falls, WHO warns.

articles.title: IOM warns trafficking networks are booming

articles.title: क्या ईरान की ढाल बनेगा चीन? हथियार सौदे की रिपोर्ट से अमेरिका में हलचल
articles.summary: चीन ईरान को हथियार देने पर अमेरिका में हलचल, ट्रंप ने दिया बयान। दोनों देश एक-दूसरे के सैन्य ठिकानों को निशाना बना रहे हैं। इस बीच चीन निर्मित 400 शोल्डर-फायर एयर डिफेंस मिसाइल लॉन्चर की पहली खेप जल्द ईरान पहुंचने की खबर से अमेरिका में हलचल बढ़ गई है। राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने इस मामले पर बड़ा बयान दिया है।
